definition: AbstractConcreteDisjoint abstract concrete means ∀ x, abstract x → ¬ concrete x, for independently supplied classification predicates. It does not define either classification or assert that every candidate belongs to one of them.
note: An explicit additional policy if the power-to-concreteness premise is used to exclude powers of abstract candidates. No classification of passive recipients as abstract and no abstract inability to be caused follows. The policy is not established or automatically assumed. See docs/notes/causal-power-concreteness.md.
